title: Cuppini 2011 · Superior colliculus maturation
citation: Cuppini, C., Magosso, E., & Ursino, M. (2011). Organization, maturation, and plasticity of multisensory integration: Insights from computational modeling studies. Frontiers in Psychology, 2, 77.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.initial_state: Negligible descending AES inputs and weak ascending inputs with broad receptive fields.
published_method.training: Hebbian training with modality and position draws. Use capped summed input weights.
published_method.evaluation: Compare cospatial and discrepant audiovisual effects on steady-state SC activity before and after learning.

stimulus_type.value: Spatial visual and auditory network inputs
stimulus_type.source: Cuppini 2011, pp. 6–8, Maturation of multisensory integrative capabilities, Fig. 5 and discussion

value.spatial_representation: One-dimensional topological chains with overlapping receptive fields
value.unit: Sigmoid with threshold and saturation plus low-pass response
value.lateral_connections: Mexican-hat excitation nearby and inhibition at larger distances
value.input_competition: Interneurons suppress ascending inputs under AES influence and mediate competition among ascending modalities

value.initial_state: Descending AES synapses initially negligible. Ascending synapses weak with broad spatial RFs.

training_rule.potentiation: Both pre- and postsynaptic activity above threshold
training_rule.depotentiation: Presynaptic inhibited while postsynaptic above threshold
training_rule.normalization: Cap the summed incoming synaptic strength
training_rule.plastic_paths: Descending excitatory, descending inhibitory and SC lateral pathways are described as learning

input_schedule.composition: Thousands of cross-modal and modality-specific inputs

assessment.pre_post: Repeat adult-style colocalized and spatially disparate integration tests before and after learning

value.findings: Multisensory enhancement and depression emerge after learning in the illustrated simulated SC.
value.additional_predictions: Dark rearing and training with spatially disparate inputs are discussed as predictions and preliminary simulations whose data are not reported.
